records.title: Elastic-dLLM: Position Preserving Context Compression and Augmentation of Diffusion LLMs
records.reason: arXiv abstract proposes position-preserving masked-token compression that removes redundant diffusion-LLM computation and accelerates decoding.

records.title: When Is a Draft Accepted? A Theory of Acceptance in Speculative Decoding
records.reason: arXiv abstract develops acceptance guarantees for practical greedy, relaxed, and tree speculative decoding, a direct inference acceleration method.

records.title: An Evolved Universal Transformer Memory
records.reason: arXiv abstract introduces learned neural attention memory management that reduces transformer input context while improving performance and efficiency.

records.title: SelfJudge: Faster Speculative Decoding via Self-Supervised Judge Verification
records.reason: arXiv abstract states speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference and presents self-supervised judge verification to relax draft-token verification.

records.title: RADAR: Accelerate Large Language Model Inference With RL-Based Dynamic Draft Trees
records.reason: arXiv abstract uses offline RL to dynamically size speculative draft trees, reduce redundant draft-model calls, and accelerate inference.

records.title: Oilbird: Training-Free Speculative Decoding with Keys the Verifier Already Computes
records.reason: arXiv abstract describes training-free speculative decoding that improves lookup of reusable verifier-side context for faster decoding.

records.title: TAPS: Task Aware Proposal Distributions for Speculative Sampling
records.reason: arXiv abstract evaluates task-specific speculative drafters and proposal distributions for autoregressive generation acceleration.

records.title: Efficient Agentic LLM Serving over SSD-based Sparse KV Storage
records.reason: arXiv abstract addresses efficient agentic LLM serving with SSD-backed sparse KV storage to reduce attention work and retain history KV.

records.title: VisMMOE: Exploiting Visual-Expert Affinity for Efficient Visual-Language MoE Offloading
records.reason: arXiv abstract presents a visual-language MoE offloading system using visual-token pruning to reduce computation and expert working-set costs.

records.title: WavePP: High-Throughput Pipeline Parallel LLM Prefill under Prefix Reuse
records.reason: arXiv abstract presents a TensorRT-LLM prefill runtime that coordinates cross-stage prefix reuse and request admission to improve throughput.

records.title: From Static Inference to Dynamic Interaction: Navigating the Landscape of Streaming Large Language Models
records.reason: arXiv abstract surveys streaming LLM architectures for dynamic real-time interaction; this is directly about inference execution systems and methods.

records.title: Plug-and-Play 1.x-Bit KV Cache Quantization for Video Large Language Models
records.reason: arXiv abstract proposes sub-2-bit KV-cache quantization for VideoLLMs to reduce inference memory bottlenecks from visual tokens.

records.title: Practical Online KV Cache Compaction for LLM Agents: An Empirical Study
records.reason: arXiv abstract studies online KV-cache compaction for LLM agents, directly targeting inference cache cost while considering accuracy trade-offs.

records.title: LeanQuant: Accurate and Scalable Large Language Model Quantization with Loss-error-aware Grid
records.reason: arXiv abstract proposes post-training LLM quantization aimed at lowering model memory requirements and decoding latency.

records.title: FPTQuant: Function-Preserving Transforms for LLM Quantization
records.reason: arXiv abstract proposes lightweight function-preserving transforms to enable efficient LLM quantization and inference.

records.title: Neural Weight Compression for Language Models
records.reason: arXiv abstract formulates language-model weight compression as neural codec learning and reports accuracy-compression trade-offs for deployment.

records.title: Nearly Optimal Attention Coresets
records.reason: arXiv abstract proves small-space attention approximation via coresets over a reduced key-value set, relevant to attention memory/computation.

records.title: Improving Model Representation and Reducing KV Cache via Skip Connections with First Value Heads
records.reason: arXiv abstract proposes first-value-head skip connections that improve representation while reducing autoregressive KV-cache cost.

records.title: Dependency-Aware Semi-Structured Sparsity of GLU Variants in Large Language Models
records.reason: arXiv abstract proposes dependency-aware semi-structured pruning for GLU-based LLMs, targeting hardware-oriented sparsity and inference latency.
